Each player gets a permanent unique Player ID (shown greyed out) that the rest of the system — batting/bowling dropdowns, ball log, stats — always keys off, never just their name. Untick "XI" to bench someone as a substitute without deleting them; benched players won't appear in the live dropdowns. If a squad is left empty, the Striker/Non-striker/Bowler fields below fall back to free-text entry exactly as before. "📋 Import from List" reads player names out of an uploaded photo/PDF of a printed or handwritten roster, so you don't have to type each one in.

    🪙 Toss — who won, and what they chose

    Auto-set "Batting team" from this result
    Current rule: the toss winner only ever chooses to Bat or Bowl first — there's no separate "field" option, that's just the commentary term for bowling first. With auto-set on, picking a decision here immediately updates the Batting Team field above (and everything downstream — score side, chase target, etc.) so you don't have to set it twice.

    🏆 Match Type — single match or tournament

    Single Match mode: this match stays on its own — nothing is saved to a tournament.
    No single matches saved yet.
    Saves itself the instant a match is won or tied — kept completely separate from any tournament, so it never shows up in a tournament's match list or stat cards. Click a saved match to reopen its full scorecard.
    No tournament selected — pick one above, or start a new one, to begin tracking it.
    Create New Match starts a fresh, empty match in this same tournament. The match already saved stays exactly as it is — nothing is deleted or overwritten, and the current panel is NOT saved on the way out (use Save This Match first if this match is still unsaved). Schedule Upcoming Match saves a fixture (date, the two teams with their logos, colours and players) into 📋 Matches — the panel is not touched. Teams you create there are saved and offered again for every later match. Press ▶ Start on it there when the match begins; it goes live on the tournament page like any other match.
    Saves itself the instant a match is won or tied — this button is only needed to save mid-match or re-save after a correction. Team, batter and bowler "Tournament" cards pull straight from every match saved in this tournament, matched automatically by name — nothing to type by hand. "Mark Tournament as Completed" is what actually makes the public Tournaments page show "Completed" — just saving matches no longer does that on its own. "Delete Entire Tournament" removes every match saved under it, permanently.

      🔁 Impact Player

      One substitute per team. The substitute replaces a player of the Playing XI for the rest of the match — the replaced player cannot bat, bowl or field again.

      🏏 Penalty Runs

      Awarded by the umpire — not a delivery. No ball is bowled, no batsman is credited.
      Penalty options could not be loaded.

      🏏 Overthrow

      —
      A boundary from an overthrow is worth 4. A 6 requires the ball to have been struck over the boundary by the bat, which a fielder's throw was not (Law 19.7).

      ✏️ Edit Scorecard

      Delete the most recent ball to correct it. This can only remove balls starting from the end — deleting an older ball also removes every ball recorded after it, which you'll need to re-score.

      🖥️ LED Screen Output (Ground Display)

      Open this link fullscreen on the ground LED control PC (or any laptop/TV for testing). It updates live from this same panel — no manual entry needed there.

      📋 Scorecard Link (Public View)

      Share this link with viewers — opens a live, read-only full scorecard in a new tab.

      🎬 Match Recording

      Not recording
      One click does everything now: this also starts Record inside vMix itself (needs the Clipper Helper below, with vMix's Web Controller enabled). FOUR / SIX / WICKET will auto-cut a 20s clip and upload it to your Drive folder.

      🎥 Clipper Helper

      Checking…
      First time on this PC? Put the Clipper Launcher in the ClipperHelper folder and run its setup once — then ▶ Start Clipper does everything. ⬇️ Download Clipper Launcher
      1. Unzip it into the same folder as ClipperHelper.exe.
      2. Double-click install-clipper-launcher.bat once — it says DONE.
      3. Click ▶ Start Clipper. The first time Chrome asks to open a program: tick Always allow → Open.
      Clips (newest first) — ⏳ wait → ✂️ cutting locally → 💾 saved locally → R2 → Drive → website. No internet? The clip is still cut and saved; it syncs by itself when the connection is back.

      📊 Summary Graphics — auto on/off + show anytime

      Innings Summary (auto, right after each innings ends)
      Match Summary (auto, 10s after the match is won)
      The toggles above only control whether the pop-up fires automatically. The "Show Now" buttons work anytime, independent of the toggles, and always pull whatever is currently live — nothing needs to be re-entered.

      🃏 Player & Bowler Stat Cards — batter left, bowler right, on/off anytime

      Player Stat Card
      Bowler Stat Card (current bowler)
      Team Tournament Stats
      Flip any switch ON and its card comes in with the team's logo, name and colour — the batter's on the left, the bowler's on the right, so both can be up together; flip it OFF and it goes back out. "This Match" updates live, ball by ball. "Tournament" (and the Team card, which is always tournament-scoped) pull automatically from every match saved under the selected tournament in the Match Type panel, matched by team/player name — if a name has no saved matches yet, the typed-in fields above are used instead.
